notes.title: Patch 1.021 is here! 🎉
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Builders,[/h1][p]
We want to start by expressing our heartfelt thanks to every single one of you for your amazing support, dedication, and enthusiasm. Your passion is what drives us to keep improving the game every day. A special thank you goes out to everyone who took part in the beta testing of this patch—your feedback has been absolutely invaluable.
Thanks to the interest in the beta version, we’re expanding our beta testing platform for future patches. If you’d like to be among the first to test upcoming updates, make sure to follow us on our [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.com%2Finvite%2FNhSSztvEWG"][b]Discord[/b][/url][b] channel: [/b]—we’ll be sharing all testing opportunities and announcements there!
[/p][hr][/hr][h3]⚖️ Gameplay Balance Improvements[/h3][h3]In this patch, we’ve made significant balance adjustments based on your feedback:[/h3][list][*][p]Iron-related crafting balance changes - Iron Parts, Metal Tools and Machines[/p][/*][*][p]Refined Jade - balance cost of crafting[/p][/*][*][p]Balance changes in extracting tools - hatchet and pickaxe damage in primitive and improved version are fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Added some missing requirements building materials in various structures (Nine-arch Bridge, Farm)
[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🛠️ Core Gameplay Fixes[/h3][h3]We’ve also made crucial improvements to game mechanics and addressed several bugs:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed major bug which blocks village managment menu[/p][/*][*][p]Quest items are now not tradeable[/p][/*][*][p]Machines Kits are now not a Quest item[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug which allow to destruct machines and some other obects by hatchet[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some minor warehouse issues: travel point position change, build collision expansion to cover for travel point, delete old travel points[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bugs in Heavenly Ladder Monument - Building Progress issue and missing materials in few ghosts[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug which occurs when saving while building Nine-arch Bridge (objectives “Destruct wooden scaffolds”)[/p][/*][*][p]Building progress should be shown after placing fundaments[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some minor farming system bugs[/p][/*][*][p]Further fixes on save system and loading sequences[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed broken snapping Wide and Narrow Scaffold with Ladder[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🧭 UI & UX Improvements[/h3][h3]We’re continuing to enhance the user interface for a smoother, more intuitive experience:[/h3][list][*][p]Keyshorts durign crafting issues -[/p][list][*][p]fixed bug which blocks crafting station/menu when using keyshorts during crafting[/p][/*][*][p]fixed bug which change handcraft menu with crafting station menu[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Add missing icon for artisian workshop in the village managment menu[/p][/*][*][p]Add missing knowledge menu entry about Iron Bars[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorials in Knowledge Menu are now scalling better[/p][/*][*][p]Requirment resources in journal should now properly count items from Players inventory and caravan[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some of problems related with mouse cursor loses focus[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed repeatedly appearing “new unlock” pop-up[/p][/*][*][p]Only valid saves will be shown in load save menu[/p][/*][*][p]Add some optional navigation in various menus[/p][/*][*][p]Added version Number in Main Menu and in Pause Menu[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🧾 ...And That’s Not All![/h3][p]These are just some of the most impactful changes introduced in this patch. Here’s the list of the remaining fixes we managed to include in this patch — we hope there’s something in it for everyone! 😊:
[i]
Collectible Foliage / plants[/i]
[/p][list][*][p]Desert Collectible Foliage updated and fixed - Coriander should be easier to find[/p][/*][*][p]Mountain area - more bayleaf to find[/p][/*][*][p]Lotus are now visible with outline[/p][/*][/list][p]Quests
[/p][list][*][p]Quest givers from later stage of the game wont have tooltip before Player could interact[/p][/*][*][p]The Locust Plague, The Bandit King's Challenge, The Emperor’s Lotus Garden - fixed broken objectives[/p][/*][*][p]Minor fixes in quests: The Decorative Arts, The Weaver Girl and the Cowherd, Silk Road Merchant[/p][/*][*][p]Add some missing intrest point markers[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed optional dialogue in Engineering II quest, which could crash the game[/p][/*][/list][p]NPC
[/p][list][*][p]Fisherman should spawn in correct position (not underground)[/p][/*][*][p]Village workers can now grow dye plants[/p][/*][/list][p]Dialogue
[/p][list][*][p]Fixed empty dialogue option which crashed game[/p][/*][*][p]Add missing dialogue voiceovers in Metalworking and The Negotiation quests[/p][/*][/list][p]Audio
[/p][list][*][p]Water audio effects in River area should be less intense (mainly when building nine-arch bridge)[/p][/*][*][p]Added missing audio effects for some decorations - bells and gongs[/p][/*][*][p]Minor fixes: jun footsteps, windmill sound fix on river, added workshop ambiences on level river, npc sounds updates[/p][/*][*][p]Audio level during loading screens should be adjusted according to audio settings[/p][/*][*][p]Music system should now change tracks properly[/p][/*][*][p]Lesser fixes in FMOD banks and VO files[/p][/*][/list][p]3D Graphic
[/p][list][*][p]Assets at Viewpoints should now not levitate[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🚀 What’s Next?[/h3][p]Our journey doesn’t stop here! We’re already working hard on several exciting patches planned over the next [b]two months[/b], packed with new features, improvements, and community-requested changes. Stay tuned and don’t miss out—follow us on [b]TikTok[/b], [b]Instagram[/b], [b]Twitter[/b], and [b]YouTube [/b]to keep up with everything that’s coming.[/p][p]Once again, thank you all for being part of this journey. Together, we’re building something truly special, and we can’t wait to see where we go next—with you right alongside us. [/p][hr][/hr][h3]🙌 Special Thanks to Players who joined the closed beta [/h3][p][b]A massive thank you[/b] to the amazing members of our community who helped test this patch and provided us with critical insights and bug reports. We couldn’t have done it without you![/p][hr][/hr][h3]ːsteamthumbsupː We’d love to hear your thoughts and ideas for future patches! [/h3][p]Your feedback truly shapes the direction of the game. While we may not always reply right away, we read every message and deeply appreciate the time you take to share your suggestions. Stay in touch — your voice matters to us![/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.02 | Fixes, Balancing, and the Road Ahead
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40819211/27426664b136160da1cb0ec4353269fd162a88bc.png"][/img][/p][h1]Hello, Builders![/h1][p][/p][p]Since launch, we’ve been overwhelmed by your support, feedback, and bug reports - thank you for being so active and involved. It means the world to us.[/p][p]We might be a small team, but we're listening closely and working hard to improve Chinese Frontiers with every patch. Today, we’re rolling out Update 1.02, which brings a wide range of bug fixes, quality-of-life changes, and balance tweaks across farming, gathering, crafting, and quest progression.[/p][p]Let’s take a look at what’s new!

[/p][previewyoutube="PK8Zmv98gho;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]Polished and Patched[/h2][p]This update addresses some of the more disruptive bugs we’ve seen reported. From syncing issues in cutscenes to rice field snapping, cave resource issues, and visual glitches - many of these problems should now be behind us.[/p][p]We’ve also made fixes to desert foliage, collision issues, and a few quest blockers that were holding back progress. If you ran into a bug while farming or noticed missing textures in monuments - those should be sorted now.[/p][p][/p][h2]Farming Reworked[/h2][p]We heard you loud and clear - plant growth was too fast and rewards too random. With Patch 1.02, crop growth times have been rebalanced for a more natural pace, and drop rates have been increased across the board. You’ll also start finding seeds more often when gathering plants – helping you plan ahead.[/p][p][/p][h2]Village Life Improvements[/h2][p]Your villagers are smarter now, too! They’ll gather more per tool and prioritize the most caloric food when eating. We’ve also made some changes to how fishing rods are used in storage and adjusted how resources stack.[/p][p][/p][h2]Quest and Journal [/h2][p]Dozens of quests received updated objectives, fixed VO/texts, or adjusted NPC positions for better visibility. We’ve also added item reset options to several main quests in case important items were lost - helping prevent blockers in progression.[/p][p][/p][h2]That’s not all - check out the full changelog: [/h2][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where crops would grow instantly if players clicked repeatedly while planting[/p][/*][*][p]Desert map foliage: plants are now correctly visible and harvestable[/p][/*][*][p]River cave: fixed issue preventing iron ore collection[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing textures in the Desert map's Outpost Monument[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the model of Jun rice fields[/p][/*][*][p]Cutscene audio, subtitles, and video should be synced[/p][/*][*][p]Improved performance on the Desert map[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Settings Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Language tutorial update[/p][/*][*][p]Mei’s animals should no longer despawn[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Additions:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Knowledge Menu now shows snail entry[/p][/*][*][p]Added source information for notes.title: Join Our Free Playtest: Discover the New Desert Level in "Chinese Frontiers"!
notes.content:
Hello, Chinese Builders!

We’re thrilled to announce a special opportunity for you to experience a slice of our upcoming builder/simulator game, "Chinese Frontiers." Dive into our short, free playtest and be among the first to traverse the sands of our newly designed desert level!

[h2]What Awaits in the Desert? [/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Explore the Jiayu Bastion:[/b] Navigate through the evolving fort and get a glimpse of the majestic General Tower of Jiayu Pass.
[*] [b]New Gameplay Mechanics: [/b]Test your skills with our innovative machine assembly process, learn about sculpting and wood painting, and interact with our dynamic NPCs.
[/list]

[h2]How to Join the Adventure:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Accessing the playtest is easy! Simply go to the [b]“Chinese Frontiers” Steam page[/b], scroll to the “[b]Join the Chinese Frontiers Playtest[/b]” section, and click “[b]Request Access.[/b]”
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1640820/Chinese_Frontiers/]Steam Page[/url]
[*] Remember, this journey through the sands is available for a limited time. The playtest will [b]end on December 22nd.[/b]
[/list]

[h2]Your Voice Matters:[/h2]

[list]
[*] We deeply value your feedback. After your adventure, please share your thoughts through the [b]Feedback Survey[/b] → Links are inside the playtest.
[*] Your insights help us refine gameplay, fix bugs, and enhance the overall experience.
[/list]

[h2]Stay Engaged:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Thank you for being part of this journey! If you like what you see, don't forget to a[b]dd "Chinese Frontiers" to your Steam wishlist[/b] to keep up with all our updates.
[*] Join our vibrant community on [url=https://discord.com/invite/5qEmumzg3z]Discord[/url] to discuss your experiences and stay connected.
[/list]

We can’t wait to see how you leave your mark on the Silk Road!

Happy Building and Exploring!
The "Chinese Frontiers" Team

notes.title: Chinese Frontiers: DevLog #3
notes.content:
Hello! My name is Iza, and I'm a 3D Graphic Designer for Chinese Frontiers. In today's devlog, you will learn a bit about the process of [b]modelling the buildings[/b] (workshops) that you will soon be able to construct on your own in our upcoming game!

[h2][b]Research and sketching [/b][/h2]

Like almost everyone on our team, I am an architect - and thanks to this, when designing buildings, I paid attention to [b]historical accuracy with traditional Chinese constructions.[/b] Before the actual modeling, I spent a lot of time on research. I used old sketches, books and films to better understand the whole process. It was definitely a very interesting stage of my job. 😃

After the research, it was time for design. Work on each building started with a sketch of the [b]functional plan[/b] - so that its final form would be derived from the function it is intended to serve. During that time I also made a lot of loose sketches, as a way of thinking about possible forms. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40819211/f4ddeb214f911525c33811ffa9378fc0353ee581.png[/img]

[h2][b]2D to 3D transformation [/b][/h2]

The next, and really important step, was gradual [b]transition from 2D to 3D.[/b] I created a lot of simple block models for each buildings - different alternatives - so that, even in 3D, before the final modeling, the scale, proportion, and arrangement of each building could be better sensed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40819211/2e975cf94bf81bf90186a32d9d9ad80c9d6ebd2c.png[/img]

As a result, each of the buildings gained a blocky, simple form for further work. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40819211/a7e32b1fc60d33873de44c2ab00f314a8b8cdd69.png[/img]

Traditional Chinese wooden constructions often utilize intricate wood joinery techniques, where wooden pieces are interconnected without the use of nails or screws. Instead, interlocking joints are carefully crafted to create stable and durable structures. In Chinese Frontiers, you’ll be able to construct five different [b]workshops[/b], each of them has a different structure, tailored to the scale of the object and the function it is intended to serve.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40819211/da01e7ca1afe5359abc2e8830f14a657cd8b9a9a.png[/img]

[h2][b]Texturing[/b][/h2]

Final step was [b]detailed modelling and texturing.[/b] Here is a comparison between the initial sketch version of the building and its final form:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40819211/afe71d257f700ea7b35eb804d28e304d5f4a6eee.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40819211/358bc5cc0e2113fdc9d40757a06cad8604a5564c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40819211/9e280bb2cd3b0df50dd5a91544486c4ffde494d5.png[/img]

[h2][b]Upgrade your workshop[/b][/h2]

One of the key features of the game is the development of buildings. As you progress in your skills, gain new technology and gather the necessary materials, you will be able to [b]upgrade[/b] some of your [b]workshops[/b] - from a primitive structure made of field stones and clay, to a more advanced and visually appealing one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40819211/87d8f2e846d6424f4ec80bdff0c6832d76e89449.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40819211/45623385f0385c4009f4bc95725377ca7ffbb548.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40819211/f28e9ed2abcebf5fe2aa575fe8c7ef0d050d9072.png[/img]

This is just a small portion of the objects that you will be able to build in Chinese Frontiers. Next time, I will tell you more about other assets that I have prepared for the game - as well as take a closer look inside the workshops to examine the crafting stations. 

[b]There is so much to discover ahead of you! 🤗 [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40819211/890c680c96dac037589331431030ab38972a0aa0.png[/img]

tags.feature: In Chinese Frontiers, you’ll be able to construct five different workshops, each of them has a different structure, tailored to the scale of the object and the function it is intended to serve.
One of the key features of the game is the development of buildings.

As you progress in your skills, gain new technology and gather the necessary materials, you will be able to upgrade some of your workshops - from a primitive structure made of field stones and clay, to a more advanced and visually appealing one.
